meta.name: Campaign Play-Along
meta.description: Join the MythosBusters Discord server for the Campaign Play-Along!
meta.author: CPA Organizers

cards.name: In the Thick of It
cards.text:
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, suffer 2 total physical and/or mental trauma. Then, choose one card name. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Hunted
cards.text: Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, choose one card name. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign. Forced - When the first Mythos phase of the game begins: Reveal cards from the top of the encounter deck until you reveal an enemy. Draw that card. Shuffle the encounter deck.

cards.name: Isolated
cards.text:
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation and only if there is a single investigator in the campaign.
Choose one card name. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: See Beyond
cards.text:
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, add a random basic weakness to your deck. Then, choose a card cycle (such as Edge of the Earth.) That cycle is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Zealot's Sacrifice
cards.text:
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, choose either Core/Revised Core and Return to the Night of the Zealot, or the Investigator Starter Decks: remove the chosen set from your card pool for the duration of this campaign. Then, choose a card cycle (such as The Dream-Eaters or Edge of the Earth.) The chosen cycle is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Legacy of Dunwich
cards.text:
[reaction] When you complete the Dunwich Legacy CPA: Announce your completion in the Mythos Busters Discord server. The next time you participate in a CPA, you may accept this contract.
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, choose one card from the Dunwich Legacy expansion. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Victory Lap
cards.text: [reaction] If you confronted Cthulhu at the Sepulchre of the Sleeper, accepted the That Which Can Eternal Lie contract, or played Doom of Arkham Part II using the Ultimatum of the Sleeper, you may accept this contract the next time you participate in a CPA. Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, earn 1 experience.

cards.name: Wake of Cthulhu
cards.text:

Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, choose one card from the Drowned City expansion. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Waking Dreams
cards.text:
[reaction] When you complete The Dream-Eaters CPA, announce your completion in the Mythos Busters Discord server: The next time you participate in a CPA, you may accept this contract.
Permanent. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, choose one card from The Dream-Eaters expansion. That card is added to your card pool for the duration of this campaign.

cards.name: Exotic Equipment
cards.text: Boon. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When spending supply points during the Prologue, any investigator may spend 2 supply points to choose one card name. That card is added to their card pool for the duration of this campaign. (Investigators may do this any number of times.)

cards.name: "Abandoned" Stockpile
cards.text: Ultimatum. Accept this contract only during deck creation. During the Prologue, investigators gain a total of 4 additional supply points, distributed as evenly as possible. Forced – When gathering cards during setup, gather all cards from the Guardians of Time encounter set. Investigators cannot parley with Ichtaca during Scenario I: The Untamed Wilds.

cards.name: Gaze of Yig
cards.text: Ultimatum. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, choose 1[per_investigator] card names. Those cards are added to the card pool for the duration of this campaign. Forced – When the game begins: Add this card to the victory display for the duration of the game. (It will not be counted towards Yig's Fury.) Vengeance 1

cards.name: Progeny of Yig
cards.text: Accept this contract only during deck creation. While there are 1 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you cannot become poisoned. While there are 2 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you get -1 health and gain the [[Serpent]] trait. While there are 3 or more vengeance points in the victory display, you get -1 to each of your skills. Forced – When the game ends, if you have the [[Serpent]] trait: You suffer 1 physical or mental trauma (your choice).

cards.name: Malignant Venom
cards.text:
Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, add a Poisoned weakness to your deck. Then, choose a card cycle (such as The Drowned City). That cycle is added to your card pool for the duration of the campaign.
Poisoned weaknesses cannot be removed from your deck.

cards.name: Intrusive Memories
cards.text: Revelation - Discard 1 non-weakness card at random from your hand. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record "alien recollections." If this was already recorded, remove Intrusive Memories from your deck, search the collection for Unexplained Blackouts, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Unexplained Blackouts
cards.text: Revelation - Discard 1 non-weakness card at random from your hand and lose 1 action. In your Campaign Log, under your investigator's earned story assets/weaknesses, record "usurped consciousness." If this was already recorded, remove Unexplained Blackouts from your deck, search the collection for Mental Displacement, and place it on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Mental Displacement
cards.text: Revelation - A Yithian projects its consciousness into your body. For the remainder of the campaign, replace your investigator card with a Body of a Yithian investigator card. Remove Mental Displacement from your deck, search the collection for Out of Body Experience, and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.name: Expedition Leader
cards.text: Leo Anderson deck only. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, record "Torches" under your Supplies. Forced - When an [[Ally]] asset you control is defeated, or you discard an [[Ally]] asset from your hand: Test [willpower](3). If you fail, take 1 direct horror.
cards.flavor: "I am not here to be your friend; I am responsible for you not dying."

cards.name: Trailblazer
cards.text: Ursula Downs deck only. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, record "Map" under your Supplies. Forced - After another investigator reveals a location: Shuffle the top card of the encounter deck into the exploration deck.

cards.name: Excavation Specialist
cards.text: Monterey Jack deck only. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, record "Rope" under your Supplies. Forced - After a [[Serpent]] enemy engages you: You must decide (choose one): [bullet] Run: Test [agility](X) where X is that enemy's evade value. If you succeed, disengage with that enemy and it cannot engage you for the remainder of the round. If you fail, you must choose a different option. [bullet] Hide: Lose 1 action. [bullet] Cower: Take 1 horror.

cards.name: Medical Missionary
cards.text:
Father Mateo deck only.
Accept this contract only during deck creation.
When you accept this contract, record "Medicine" under your Supplies.
While an investigator is poisoned, you have -1 [willpower].
[reaction] When an investigator would become poisoned: If Father Mateo's "[reaction]" ability has not been used this scenario, cancel that effect. This counts as a use of Father Mateo's "[reaction]" ability.
cards.flavor: "They will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well."

cards.name: Wildlife Expert
cards.text: Miguel de la Cruz deck only. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, record "Binoculars" under your Supplies. Forced - When an enemy with Vengeance X is added to the victory display: Discard X cards from your hand at random.
cards.flavor: "Want to hold her? She won't bite."

cards.name: Doul Jones Indexing
cards.text: Accept this contract only during deck creation. Limit 1 per campaign. You get +1 deck size. Your investigator's Deckbuilding Requirements gains: "1 copy of Marcus Sengstacke." You may treat damage or horror that would be dealt to Marcus Sengstacke as direct damage or horror instead. Forced - When your first turn of the game begins: Lose 1 action and search your hand, deck, and discard pile for a copy of Marcus Sengstacke and play him (paying his cost). Forced - When the game ends, if Marcus Sengstacke is not in play: You suffer 1 mental trauma.

cards.name: Scapegoat
cards.text: Calvin Wright deck only. Multiplayer only. Accept this contract only during deck creation. When you accept this contract, record "Pendant" under your Supplies. Forced - When any amount of damage and/or horror would be placed on another investigator at your location: Place that damage and/or horror on Calvin Wright.
cards.flavor: "Of course the expedition failed! We brought [[him]] along!"
